docs.summary: CPU-side description of a texture referenced by a [`Material`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Material).
docs.remarks: Image bytes are NOT decoded. External references expose [`SourcePath`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Texture~SourcePath); embedded images expose [`EncodedBytes`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Texture~EncodedBytes) holding the original encoded file (PNG/JPG/KTX2/etc.). The engine performs decoding and GPU upload.

docs.summary: Texture name, or `null` when the source did not name it.
Resolved absolute path to the source image file when the texture references an external file, or `null` when the texture is only available via [`EncodedBytes`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Texture~EncodedBytes).
Encoded image bytes (PNG/JPG/KTX2/etc.) when the texture is embedded in the source file (GLB chunk, data URI) or when the `EmbedTextures` post-process step was run, otherwise `null`.
MIME type of the image data (e.g. `image/png`), when known.
Sampler state: wrap modes, filter modes, mipmap generation hint.
